# GitHub Actions workflows

Both workflows here keep `public/schemas/eof-eos-schema.json` in sync with the
RDF/SKOS thesaurus sources under `scripts/rdf/` and `scripts/skosmos/`. They
run the conversion scripts documented in [`scripts/README.md`](../../scripts/README.md),
commit the regenerated output back to the branch that was pushed, and mirror
the published schema files to the `gh-pages` branch.

## `convert-rdf.yml` — Convert RDF thesaurus

**Triggers:** push to `main` that touches
- `scripts/rdf/DataModelEnumeratedProperties.rdf`
- `scripts/rdf/producttypes.rdf`

These are hand-maintained RDF sources (not generated by another workflow).

**Steps:**
1. Checkout, setup Node 22.
2. `bash scripts/convert-rdf.sh` — converts every `*.rdf` file under
   `scripts/rdf/` into JSON Schema, merges them, and embeds the result into
   `public/schemas/eof-eos-schema.json`.
3. Commit `public/schemas/eof-eos-schema.json` back to the pushed branch
   (skipped if nothing changed).
4. Checkout `gh-pages` into a `gh-pages/` subfolder, copy over the
   regenerated `eof-eos-schema.json` and `thesaurus-rdf/thesaurus.json`, and
   commit/push them to `gh-pages`.

## `extract-and-convert-thesaurus.yml` — Extract and convert ESA thesaurus

**Triggers:** push to `main` that touches `scripts/skosmos/esa-thesauri.rdf`
(the raw ESA Skosmos export).

**Steps:** runs the three conversion scripts in the order required (see
`scripts/README.md`), then commits and mirrors the results the same way as
`convert-rdf.yml`:
1. `bash scripts/extract-platforms-and-instruments.sh` — extracts the
   platforms and instruments concept schemes from `esa-thesauri.rdf` into
   `scripts/rdf/platforms.rdf` and `scripts/rdf/instruments.rdf`.
2. `bash scripts/convert-rdf.sh` — converts those (plus any other RDF under
   `scripts/rdf/`) into JSON Schema and embeds them into
   `public/schemas/eof-eos-schema.json`.
3. `bash scripts/update-instruments-mapping.sh` — extracts the
   platform/instrument relationships from `esa-thesauri.rdf` into
   `scripts/mapping/platform-instruments-allof.json` and embeds that mapping
   into `public/schemas/eof-eos-schema.json`.
4. Commit `scripts/rdf/platforms.rdf`, `scripts/rdf/instruments.rdf`,
   `scripts/mapping/platform-instruments-allof.json`,
   `public/schemas/thesaurus-rdf/`, and `public/schemas/eof-eos-schema.json`
   back to the pushed branch (skipped if nothing changed).
5. Mirror the regenerated schema files to `gh-pages`, same as step 4 of
   `convert-rdf.yml`.

## Why the triggers don't overlap

`extract-and-convert-thesaurus.yml` regenerates `scripts/rdf/platforms.rdf`
and `scripts/rdf/instruments.rdf` and pushes them to `main`. Those files are
therefore deliberately **excluded** from `convert-rdf.yml`'s path filters —
`extract-and-convert-thesaurus.yml` already runs `convert-rdf.sh` itself in
the same job, so letting `convert-rdf.yml` also trigger on those paths would
just re-run the same conversion a second time on every ESA thesaurus update.

## Common setup

Both workflows need `permissions: contents: write` to push their commits,
and push directly to the branch that triggered them
(`HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}`) as well as to `gh-pages`, so the default
`GITHUB_TOKEN` must have write access and branch protection on `main` must
allow the `github-actions[bot]` actor to push (or these commits will fail
silently past the "no changes to commit" check).
